user_decision: 2026-11-19: user finds a hand-set threshold awkward for the paper; approved rerunning the main system with the threshold given by the data procedure (GPU about 1.2 h) and one optional sensitivity point.
question: If the stall threshold is the output of the data procedure (log-scale Otsu of the 24-step net hand displacement on rule-free rollouts) instead of the hand-set 3 mm, does the main system Q400B keep its success rate and time?
threshold: 2.5 mm = th_log of scale_rule_20261117 rule() on dev rows of unify0_20261116 NORULE (3 seeds), computed and recorded in stallc_20261119/summary.json (dev.all_rows_reference.th_log) before this study. Holdout value 2.9 mm (not used). The log scale is a post hoc choice (the eta rule picks linear 24.6 mm); disclosed.

arms.Q400S25: Q400B with RDP_STALL_MM=0.0025; seeds 20260921 / 22 / 23, cohorts 76700..76875, 600 scenes (primary)
arms.Q400S40: Q400B with RDP_STALL_MM=0.004; seed 20260921 only, 200 scenes (secondary, sensitivity)

server: policy_server_selrule_stallmm_20261119.py = stallr server with the 0.003 constant read from env RDP_STALL_MM; everything else as Q400B (Q400 ensemble, k 999, suppress, fallback 2, continuity 0.02, exec_delay 2, residual nowr_cl, rt bridge)
noise_floor_known: rrval2 trace (11-19): a 1e-8 command perturbation alone flips about 11% of scenes (net -2 / 150); seed-to-seed 156-160 / 200.
primary_analysis: paired by scene (seed, cohort, env): difference Q400S25 - Q400B in success and in RMST (first success step, 600 if none), bootstrap over scenes (5000 draws, seed 0), 95% CI

verdict.EQUIVALENT: success CI inside [-5, +5] pp AND RMST CI inside [-25, +25] steps
verdict.WORSE: success CI upper < 0 OR RMST CI lower > 0 (and not EQUIVALENT)
verdict.BETTER: success CI lower > 0 OR RMST CI upper < 0 (and not EQUIVALENT)

predictions.M3: Q400S40 seed 21 within +-10 of Q400B seed 21 (160) (secondary)

expectation: EQUIVALENT about 70%. If 2.5 mm is stricter in effect (later release), flip success drops and time rises, as with the ratio stall on 11-17.

consequence.EQUIVALENT: the paper states the procedure; the procedure-value run becomes the main result and 3 mm / 4 mm go to a sensitivity table
consequence.otherwise: reported as is; the threshold is sensitive and the definition is revisited with the user

also_reported: time of first block release if available (exploratory)
order: one GPU sim at a time; smoke (25 envs, 200 steps) first to confirm the server reads RDP_STALL_MM
